{{Quote
|Hr = Journal
|Sturdy bug lost to the Haunting. Rolls at threats with no care for its own discomfort.<hr/>A rare built bug within these ailing lands. Most pilgrims' shells seem small by comparison. What nourishment did they discover to grow so large?
}}

<b>Pilgrim Hulks</b> are rarer, larger Pilgrim [[Enemies (Silksong)|Enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. Lost to the [[Haunting]], they roll at threats without caring about their own discomfort.<ref>Pilgrim Hulk [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Sturdy bug lost to the Haunting. Rolls at threats with no care for its own discomfort."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Pilgrim Hulks slowly walk back and forth in a small area when idle. Once they have spotted Hornet, they use either of the following attacks:
* <b>Bouncing Roll:</b> Begins charging up and bounces towards Hornet twice, with the second bounce going lower than the first.
* <b>Spindash:</b> Bounces backwards briefly before gaining speed in their roll, then thunders towards Hornet until she's behind it or it hits a wall.<br>

Pilgrim Hulks often have short cooldowns after their attacks, allowing them to be hit easily. Their large hitbox size also makes certain [[Tools]] such as [[Sting Shard]]s or [[Curveclaw]]s especially effective.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Pilgrim Hulks have their health quadrupled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== Location ==
Pilgrim Hulks can be found primarily in the [[Far Fields]]. A unique Pilgrim Hulk, the [[Weary Pilgrim]], can be found at the entrance to [[Pilgrim's Rest]]. Eventually, she succumbs to the [[Haunting]] and becomes hostile. She does not respawn upon death and disappears once [[Act 3]] starts.

One Pilgrim Hulk appears as part of the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Deep Docks 2|gauntlet]] in the [[Deep Docks]], and two more appear in the [[Chapel of the Wanderer]] [[Enemy_Gauntlets_(Silksong)#Chapel_of_the_Wanderer|gauntlet]].

During [[Act 3]], two Pilgrim Hulks can be found in [[Shellwood]] attacking [[Pinmaster Plinney]].
